玛西跃向友方目标单位，选好她要弹离的方向和距离。到达目标后玛西冲向最终的目的地，对落地点的敌人造成伤害和眩晕。

回身踢设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，玛西会把她的友军目标带向最终目的地。

友军将获得25%移动速度加成，持续4秒。

before.descriptionZh:
被动使玛西获得吸血和攻击力加成。

对友军施放时，使其获得她的被动75%吸血和攻击力加成。另外马上还会给她和她的搭档制造共用的全伤害护盾。在玛西攻击英雄时，造成伤害的30%会补充护盾。

after.descriptionZh:
被动使玛西获得吸血和攻击力加成。

对友军施放时，使其获得她的75%被动吸血和攻击力加成。另外马上还会给她和她的搭档制造共用的全伤害护盾。在玛西攻击英雄时，造成伤害的30%会补充护盾。

before.descriptionEn:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers 3 bonus levels and 1 bonus health.
before.descriptionZh:
玛西吹起口哨，立刻把她的信使传送到她身边。如果信使起始于泉水，它会带上玛西储藏处内的物品。传送后会把这些物品移交给玛西，再返回泉水。

所有友方信使被动获得3级额外等级和1点额外生命。

after.descriptionEn:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers 3 bonus levels and 1 extra pip.
after.descriptionZh:
玛西吹起口哨，立刻把她的信使传送到她身边。如果信使起始于泉水，它会带上玛西储藏处内的物品。传送后会把这些物品移交给玛西，再返回泉水。

所有友方信使被动获得3级额外等级和1格额外生命。

before.descriptionEn:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

 Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.
before.descriptionZh:
獸向目标地点扔出一块岩石，对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。岩石无法扔向獸身边的最小范围内。岩石落地后会分裂成3块碎石，落在初始目标地点的后方。

砸每击中一名英雄都会增加咤的一层叠加效果。

after.descriptionEn:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns enemies and deals 300 + 100% STR damage. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

 Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.
after.descriptionZh:
獸向目标地点扔出一块岩石，对敌人造成眩晕和300+100%力量值的伤害。岩石无法扔向獸身边的最小范围内。岩石落地后会分裂成3块碎石，落在初始目标地点的后方。

砸每击中一名英雄都会增加咤的一层叠加效果。

before.descriptionEn: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for 3s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and -20% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.
before.descriptionZh: 琼英碧灵对一个敌人射出一颗幽灵子弹，造成伤害，将其击退并将其变为虚无状态，持续3秒——使他们对物理伤害免疫，并且无法攻击。目标被减速，并且承受的魔法伤害增加-20%。敌人不会被击出琼英碧灵的攻击距离。

after.descriptionEn: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for 2.25s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and -20% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.
after.descriptionZh: 琼英碧灵对一个敌人射出一颗幽灵子弹，造成伤害，将其击退并将其变为虚无状态，持续2.25秒——使他们对物理伤害免疫，并且无法攻击。目标被减速，并且承受的魔法伤害增加-20%。敌人不会被击出琼英碧灵的攻击距离。

before.descriptionEn:
Use: Proportion Distortion
Creates 1 imperfect image of your hero that lasts 18 seconds. Your illusion deals 28% and takes  300% damage.
before.descriptionZh:
使用：比例失真
制造英雄的1个不完美幻象，持续18秒。幻象继承28%攻击力，承受300%伤害。

after.descriptionEn:
Use: Proportion Distortion
Creates 1 imperfect image of your hero that lasts 18 seconds. Your illusion deals 100% and takes  300% damage.
after.descriptionZh:
使用：比例失真
制造英雄的1个不完美幻象，持续18秒。幻象继承100%攻击力，承受300%伤害。

before.descriptionEn:
Use: Whoopsie
Propels your hero forward 400 units. Leaves a 250 radius stink cloud behind for 3 seconds that slows enemies by -30%.
before.descriptionZh:
使用：噗
把英雄向前推动400距离。在身后留下一团250范围的臭云，持续3秒，使敌人减速-30%。

after.descriptionEn:
Use: Whoopsie
Propels your hero forward 400 units. Leaves a 300 radius stink cloud behind for 3 seconds that slows enemies by -35%.
after.descriptionZh:
使用：噗
把英雄向前推动400距离。在身后留下一团300范围的臭云，持续3秒，使敌人减速-35%。

before.descriptionEn:
Use: Saddle Up
Summons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for 10 seconds. 1.5s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than 20 dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.
before.descriptionZh:
使用：上车
召唤一辆快速的独轮车并骑上去，持续10秒。上车1.5秒后受到来自敌方英雄的伤害超过20点会让他下车。撞到树木会将其摧毁，并且独轮车会减速。攻击、使用持续施法类技能或者撞到单位和其他障碍物都会使他下车。

after.descriptionEn:
Use: Saddle Up
Summons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for 15 seconds. 1.5s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than 20 dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.
after.descriptionZh:
使用：上车
召唤一辆快速的独轮车并骑上去，持续15秒。上车1.5秒后受到来自敌方英雄的伤害超过20点会让他下车。撞到树木会将其摧毁，并且独轮车会减速。攻击、使用持续施法类技能或者撞到单位和其他障碍物都会使他下车。

before.descriptionEn: Kez slashes forward in a 800 distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief 100s impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
before.descriptionZh: 凯挥舞他的长刀向前沿一条直线斩击800距离，攻击区域内的敌人并施加短暂的100秒减速。经过短暂延迟后，这个区域会被再次攻击。英雄会承受额外伤害。

after.descriptionEn: Kez slashes forward in a 800 distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief 100% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again.
after.descriptionZh: 凯挥舞他的长刀向前沿一条直线斩击800距离，攻击区域内的敌人并施加短暂的100%减速。经过短暂延迟后，这个区域会被再次攻击。

before.descriptionEn:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for 1 second, becoming invulnerable for 0.2s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
before.descriptionZh:
凯进入不可控制的状态，持续1秒，0.2秒为无敌状态并获得一次弱驱散效果。

如果施法成功完成，凯会对周围发动致命的辐射状斩击，基于目标的最大生命值造成伤害，并且造成伤害的一定百分比会治疗凯。

after.descriptionEn:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for 1 second, becoming invulnerable for 0.2s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal a fixed damage attack based on the target's max health with enhanced lifesteal.
after.descriptionZh:
凯进入不可控制的状态，持续1秒，0.2秒为无敌状态并获得一次弱驱散效果。

如果施法成功完成，凯会对周围发动致命的辐射状斩击，基于目标的最大生命值造成伤害，并且具有增强的吸血效果。

before.descriptionEn: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
before.descriptionZh: 开启后凯可以向敌方目标冲去，发动的攻击会重复一次。在这个状态下，凯拥有相位移动状态和减速抗性。

after.descriptionEn: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks with reduced damage and Item Potency.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
after.descriptionZh: 开启后凯可以向敌方目标冲去，发动的攻击会重复一次，重复的攻击具有较低的伤害和物品威力。在这个状态下，凯拥有相位移动状态和减速抗性。

before.descriptionEn:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for 2 seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for 0.4s and gains a Mark.  When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
before.descriptionZh:
装备双钗时凯的攻击有几率对敌人造成致命一击。

凯可以主动开启技能，使自身被缴械，面朝方向被锁定，招架来自目标方向的攻击和攻击效果，持续2秒。如果有敌方英雄的攻击被招架，该英雄会被眩晕并获得印记，拥有印记的目标被凯攻击时必定会造成致命一击，并且被眩晕。

子技能可以用于提前取消招架状态。

after.descriptionEn:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for 1.5 seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for 0.4s and gains a Mark.  When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
after.descriptionZh:
装备双钗时凯的攻击有几率对敌人造成致命一击。

凯可以主动开启技能，使自身被缴械，面朝方向被锁定，招架来自目标方向的攻击和攻击效果，持续1.5秒。如果有敌方英雄的攻击被招架，该英雄会被眩晕0.4秒并获得印记，拥有印记的目标被凯攻击时必定会造成致命一击，并且被眩晕。

子技能可以用于提前取消招架状态。

before.descriptionEn: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemies, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
before.descriptionZh: 凯释放出一阵迷烟，对附近敌人施加标记，暂时削弱他们的视野。凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和隐身状态，直到他攻击或施法。

after.descriptionEn: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
after.descriptionZh: 凯释放出一阵迷烟，对附近敌方英雄施加标记，暂时削弱他们的视野。凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和隐身状态，直到他攻击或施法。

before.descriptionZh:
朗戈用他的舌头舔舐目标单位，把它拉回一小段距离，施加弱驱散，如果是敌人还会造成伤害。

击杀或驱散目标的效果后会使朗戈暂时获得生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散

after.descriptionZh:
朗戈用他的舌头舔舐目标单位，把它拉回一小段距离，施加弱驱散，如果是敌人还会造成伤害。

击杀目标或驱散目标的效果后都会使朗戈暂时获得生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散

before.descriptionEn: Largo plays a song that deals 20/30/40 magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
before.descriptionZh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲对附近敌人造成20/30/40点魔法伤害。乐曲还会使附近友方英雄的技能增强提升，并且他们的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。

after.descriptionEn: Largo plays a song that deals 24 / 37 / 50 magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
after.descriptionZh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲对附近敌人造成24 / 37 / 50点魔法伤害。乐曲还会使附近友方英雄的技能增强提升，并且他们的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。

before.descriptionEn:
Active: Overwhelming Blink
 Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, all enemies in a 800 AoE take damage equal to 100 + 50% of your strength and an additional 100% over time, and have 50% movement speed slow and 50 attack speed slow for 6 seconds. 

Overwhelming Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：盛势闪光
传送到最远1200距离的位置。

传送后，800范围内所有敌人受到100 + 50%力量值的瞬时伤害，并且额外持续受到总计为100%力量值的伤害，被减缓50%移动速度，降低50攻击速度，持续6秒。

Reduce your own movement speed by 20 to provide a 160 physical damage barrier to allied player controlled units in a 800 unit radius. Lasts for 6 seconds.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：盾墙
你的移动速度降低20，向800范围内玩家控制的友方单位提供一个160点物理伤害护盾。持续6秒。

after.descriptionEn:
Active: Shield Wall
Reduce your own movement speed by 20 to provide a 180 physical damage barrier to allied player controlled targets in a 800 unit radius. Lasts for 6 seconds.
after.descriptionZh:
主动：盾墙
你的移动速度降低20，向800范围内玩家控制的友方目标提供一个180点物理伤害护盾。持续6秒。

before.descriptionEn:
Active: Refract
 Spend 8% of your current life total to create a full health illusion that lasts for 20 seconds. The illusion has 50% outgoing damage and takes 200% of incoming damage.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：折射
消耗自身8%当前生命值，制造一个满血的幻象，持续20秒。幻象造成50%伤害，承受200%伤害。

after.descriptionEn:
Active: Refract
 Spend 4% of your current life total to create a full health strong illusion that lasts for 20 seconds. The illusion has 60% outgoing damage, takes 200% of incoming damage, and has 100% Item Potency.
after.descriptionZh:
Active: Refract
 Spend 4% of your current life total to create a full health strong illusion that lasts for 20 seconds. The illusion has 60% outgoing damage, takes 200% of incoming damage, and has 100% Item Potency.

before.descriptionEn:
Active: Pupate
 Enter into an insect form for 5 seconds, increasing magic resistance by 50% and movement speed by 15%. While an insect, your size is decreased and your armor is reduced by 45%.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：化蛹
进入昆虫形态，持续5秒，魔法抗性提升50%，移动速度提升15%。在昆虫形态下模型大小减少，护甲减少45%。

after.descriptionEn:
Active: Pupate
 Enter into an insect form for 5 seconds, increasing magic resistance by 40% and movement speed by 15%. While an insect, your size is decreased and your armor is reduced by 30%.
after.descriptionZh:
主动：化蛹
进入昆虫形态，持续5秒，魔法抗性提升40%，移动速度提升15%。在昆虫形态下模型大小减少，护甲减少30%。

before.descriptionEn:
Active: False Flight
 Gain 50% slow resistance, phased movement, and 25% evasion for 5 seconds.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：飞天之幻
提供50%减速抗性、相位移动和25%闪避，持续5秒。

after.descriptionEn:
Active: False Flight
 Gain 60% slow resistance, phased movement, and 40% evasion for 6.5 seconds.
after.descriptionZh:
主动：飞天之幻
提供60%减速抗性、相位移动和40%闪避，持续6.5秒。

before.descriptionEn:
Active: Bloodthirst
 Gain 15% base damage and 30 attack speed for 6 seconds.

Passive: Bloodrush
Enemy heroes dying within 1200 units reset the cooldown of Bloodthirst.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：嗜血渴望
获得15%基础攻击力，30攻击速度，持续6秒。

被动：鲜血之激
只要敌方英雄在1200范围内阵亡，嗜血渴望的冷却时间就会重置。

after.descriptionEn:
Active: Bloodthirst
 Gain 15% base damage and 30 attack speed for 9 seconds.

Passive: Bloodrush
Enemy heroes dying within 1500 units reset the cooldown of Bloodthirst.
after.descriptionZh:
主动：嗜血渴望
获得15%基础攻击力，30攻击速度，持续9秒。

被动：鲜血之激
只要敌方英雄在1500范围内阵亡，嗜血渴望的冷却时间就会重置。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Salvo
20% of the mana used to cast abilities is recovered over 10 seconds.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：齐鸣
施放技能使用的20%魔法消耗会在10秒内恢复。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Salvo
20% of the mana used to cast abilities is recovered over 8 seconds.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：齐鸣
施放技能使用的20%魔法消耗会在8秒内恢复。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Linger
 30% of incoming damage is delayed over 5 seconds.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：延缓
承受伤害的30%会延迟到5秒内施加。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Linger
 30% of incoming damage is delayed over 8 seconds.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：延缓
承受伤害的30%会延迟到8秒内施加。

before.descriptionEn:
Toggle: Transmogrify
 Toggle to switch the contents of the Satchel between a pound of Feathers or Rocks.

Feathers: increase movement speed by 12 and distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.

Rocks: increase armor by 3 and decrease the distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.
before.descriptionZh:
切换：变幻
切换会使小包里的东西在羽毛和石头之间变换。

羽毛：移动速度提升12，施加给佩戴者的强制位移效果提升30%。

石头：提升3点护甲，施加给佩戴者的强制位移效果减少30%。

after.descriptionEn:
Toggle: Transmogrify
 Toggle to switch the contents of the Satchel between a pound of Feathers or Rocks.

Feathers: increase movement speed by 15 and distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.

Rocks: increase armor by 5 and decrease the distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.
after.descriptionZh:
切换：变幻
切换会使小包里的东西在羽毛和石头之间变换。

羽毛：移动速度提升15，施加给佩戴者的强制位移效果提升30%。

石头：提升5点护甲，施加给佩戴者的强制位移效果减少30%。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Enchant
 Increases the bonuses of the item's Neutral Enchantment by 15%. Every time this item is crafted again the bonus is increased by 40%.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：附魔
使物品的中立附魔加成提升15%。每次重新打造这件物品都会使加成提升40%。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Enchant
 Increases the bonuses of the item's Neutral Enchantment by 10%. Every time this item is crafted again the bonus is increased by 35%.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：附魔
使物品的中立附魔加成提升10%。每次重新打造这件物品都会使加成提升35%。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Balance
 Gain 5% spell manacost reduction for every spell off cooldown and 6% spell amplification for every spell on cooldown.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：均衡
每个不在冷却的英雄技能提供5%魔法消耗降低，每个在冷却的技能提供6%技能增强。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Balance
 Gain 7% spell mana cost reduction for every ability off cooldown and 9% Spell Lifesteal for every ability on cooldown.
after.descriptionZh:
Passive: Balance
 Gain 7% spell mana cost reduction for every ability off cooldown and 9% Spell Lifesteal for every ability on cooldown.

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Spellover
 Dealing 100 spell damage to an enemy causes them to overheat and deal damage to their allies in a 300 unit radius. Hero targets deal 40 damage to their allies, other targets deal 15 damage.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：法术外溢
对一个敌人造成100点技能伤害就会对其附近300范围内的友军造成伤害。英雄目标对其友军造成40点伤害，其他目标造成15点伤害。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Spellover
 Dealing 150 spell damage to an enemy causes them to overheat and deal damage to their allies in a 300 unit radius. Hero targets deal 80 damage to their allies, other targets deal 20 damage.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：法术外溢
对一个敌人造成150点技能伤害就会对其附近300范围内的友军造成伤害。英雄目标对其友军造成80点伤害，其他目标造成20点伤害。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Forage
When the cooldown is ready, nearby trees that can be foraged will appear. By standing next to a tree for 1s, you can forage the tree and find flora, fungi or a bag of gold containing 30 gold.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：采菌
这件物品不在冷却时，附近能采到蘑菇的树木就会出现。在这样的树木旁站1秒后就能采到植物、蘑菇或包含30金的金袋。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Forage
When the cooldown is ready, nearby trees that can be foraged will appear. By standing next to a tree for 0.75s, you can forage the tree and find flora, fungi or a bag of gold containing 30 gold.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：采菌
这件物品不在冷却时，附近能采到蘑菇的树木就会出现。在这样的树木旁站0.75秒后就能采到植物、蘑菇或包含30金的金袋。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Brand
 Increases spell damage dealt to player controlled units by 9%.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：烙印
对玩家控制单位造成的技能伤害提升9%。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Brand
 Increases spell damage dealt to player controlled targets by 7%.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：烙印
对玩家控制目标造成的技能伤害提升7%。
